text: 欧洲央行管委Kazaks：货币政策仍需维持一些鹰派姿态。 我们必须保持警惕、谨慎。 必须在不过度损害经济的前提下控制通货膨胀。 政策必须阻止能源通胀外溢。 2027年通胀率可能大幅超过4%。 如果能源情势持续，可能需要进一步收紧货币政策。 欧洲央行无需放缓或停止量化紧缩政策。 政府债券收益率上升可能拖慢经济。 法国债券压力是对财政风险的重新定价。
text_en: ECB Governing Council member Kazaks: Monetary policy still needs to maintain some hawkish stance. We must remain vigilant and cautious. Inflation must be controlled without excessively damaging the economy. Policy must prevent energy inflation from spilling over. Inflation may significantly exceed 4% in 2027. If the energy situation persists, further monetary tightening may be needed. The ECB does not need to slow or stop quantitative tightening. Rising government bond yields may slow the economy. French bond stress is a repricing of fiscal risk.
